turns.assistant_text:
Albert Einstein (14 March 1879 – 18 April 1955) was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely recognized as one of the most influential scientists of the 20th century. He is best known for developing the theory of relativity, which revolutionized our understanding of space, time, and gravity.

### Key Achievements:
- **Nobel Prize in Physics (1921)**: Awarded for his explanation of the photoelectric effect, which was pivotal in establishing quantum theory.
- **Theory of Relativity**: Introduced the concepts of special relativity and general relativity, fundamentally changing the way we understand the universe.
- **Mass-Energy Equivalence**: Formulated the famous equation \(E=mc^2\), which expresses the equivalence of mass and energy.

Einstein's work laid the groundwork for many modern technologies and scientific advancements, and he is often regarded as the most famous scientist in history.

For more detailed information, you can refer to the following sources:
- [Nobel Prize Biography](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1921/einstein/biographical/)
- [Britannica Biography](https://www.britannica.com/biography/Albert-Einstein)
- [Wikipedia Entry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Albert_Einstein)
